Ui.Script:
BENILLA_JOURNAL_ART = "Interface\\Benilla\\journal\\" BENILLA_FISHING_ART = "Interface\\Benilla\\fishing\\" BENILLA_JOURNAL_FISH_SLOTS = 10 BENILLA_JOURNAL_PER_ROW = 5 BENILLA_JOURNAL_LEGEND_SLOTS = 4 BENILLA_JOURNAL_SLOT = 52 BENILLA_JOURNAL_XP_WIDTH = 208 -- Text on bare parchment is ink, as the mockup has it; gold stays for the title, the zone -- card and the red legend panel. BENILLA_JOURNAL_INK = { 0.27, 0.16, 0.06 } BENILLA_JOURNAL_FADED_INK = { 0.45, 0.33, 0.2 } -- The catch counts that unlock a page's three tiers: `[journal] reveal_at` in fish.toml. BENILLA_JOURNAL_REVEAL_AT = { 5, 10, 25 } BENILLA_JOURNAL_HINT = "You have heard a rumour of a legendary fish in these waters." BENILLA_JOURNAL_PROFESSIONS = { { key = "fishing", icon = "prof_fishing", live = true }, { key = "herbalism", icon = "prof_herbalism", live = true }, { key = "cooking", icon = "prof_cooking", live = true, tip = "Cooking: learn a recipe at a kitchen first" }, } -- The tip on the bookmark of a profession the character has not learned, unless its row -- names its own. BENILLA_JOURNAL_LOCKED_TIP = "Herbalism: coming soon" -- The Cooking bookmark: six Dish Pages a screen. BENILLA_JOURNAL_DISH_SLOTS = 6 BENILLA_JOURNAL_PAGES = { "Zones", "Inventory", "Progression" } -- AreaTable id to the scene `journal\zone_<key>`; a zone missing here shows no scene. BENILLA_JOURNAL_ZONE_ART = { [12] = "elwynn", [1519] = "stormwind", [44] = "redridge", [10] = "duskwood" }
-- The Herbalism tab. The plant grid holds 15 slots, the Satchel 25 and the perk list 9; the -- perk rows are `[herbalist] cap / perk_every` in herbs.toml (30 / 10). BENILLA_JOURNAL_HERB_SLOTS = 15 BENILLA_JOURNAL_HERB_SATCHEL_SLOTS = 25 BENILLA_JOURNAL_HERB_PERKS = 9 BENILLA_JOURNAL_HERB_PERK_ROWS = 3 BENILLA_JOURNAL_HERB_PERK_EVERY = 10 BENILLA_JOURNAL_HERB_UNKNOWN = "Unknown plant" BENILLA_JOURNAL_HERB_ZONE_NAMES = { [12] = "Elwynn Forest", [44] = "Redridge Mountains", [10] = "Duskwood" } BENILLA_JOURNAL_HERB_BOON = { 1, 0.82, 0 } BENILLA_JOURNAL_HERB_PACT = { 0.7, 0.45, 0.95 } -- The names of the Satchel items that fill the Tool and Consumable slots. BENILLA_JOURNAL_HERB_TOOLS = { ["Herbalist's Sickle"] = true, ["Herbalist's Trowel"] = true, ["Herbalist's Shears"] = true, } BENILLA_JOURNAL_HERB_CONSUMABLES = { ["Thyme Tea"] = true, ["Elixir of Herb Sight"] = true, ["Thorn Salve"] = true, ["Bloom Draught"] = true, ["Weedcutter's Twine"] = true, ["Forager's Charm"] = true, ["Moonwater"] = true, }
BINDING_HEADER_BENILLAFISHING = "Fishing" BINDING_NAME_TOGGLEFISHINGJOURNAL = "Toggle Fishing Journal"
-- The count of `item` the Satchel and the bags hold. function BenillaFishingJournal_ItemCount(item) local total = 0 if not item then return 0 end for i = 1, GetFishingSatchel() do local held, count = GetFishingSatchelItem(i) if held == item then total = total + count end end for bag = 0, 4 do for slot = 1, GetContainerNumSlots(bag) do local link = GetContainerItemLink(bag, slot) if link then local _, _, id = string.find(link, "item:(%d+)") if tonumber(id) == item then local _, count = GetContainerItemInfo(bag, slot) total = total + (count or 1) end end end end return total end
-- An item's icon, or the placeholder fish when the client does not know it yet. A miss -- asks the realm for the item, so the open Journal repaints until the answer lands. function BenillaFishingJournal_Icon(item) if item then local _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, texture = GetItemInfo(item) if texture then return texture end BenillaFishingJournal.missing = true end return BENILLA_FISHING_ART .. "fish" end
function BenillaFishingJournal_Pips(slot, caught, perfect, legendary) local name = slot:GetName() local on = { caught, perfect, legendary } for i = 1, 3 do local pip = getglobal(name .. "Pip" .. i) pip:SetTexture(BENILLA_FISHING_ART .. (on[i] and "pip_on" or "pip_off")) pip:Show() end end
function BenillaFishingJournal_HidePips(slot) local name = slot:GetName() for i = 1, 3 do getglobal(name .. "Pip" .. i):Hide() end end
function BenillaFishingJournal_ItemName(item) local name = item and GetItemInfo(item) if item and not name then BenillaFishingJournal.missing = true end return name or "an unknown item" end
-- A gear item's name under its slot: empty until the client knows the item. function BenillaFishingJournal_GearName(item) if not item then return "" end local name = GetItemInfo(item) if not name then BenillaFishingJournal.missing = true end return name or "" end
-- While open with an item the client has not heard of, repaint every half second. function BenillaFishingJournal_OnUpdate(elapsed) local frame = BenillaFishingJournal if not frame.missing then return end frame.retry = (frame.retry or 0) + elapsed if frame.retry >= 0.5 then frame.retry = 0 BenillaFishingJournal_Paint() end end
-- A slot's face: `state` is "caught" (the item's icon), "silhouette" (a dark fish), "dark" -- (a dark slot) or "empty" (nothing). The name under the slot is the caller's. function BenillaFishingJournal_Face(slot, state, item) local name = slot:GetName() local icon = getglobal(name .. "Icon") slot.item = item slot.caught = (state == "caught") slot.state = state getglobal(name .. "Label"):SetText("") getglobal(name .. "Name"):SetText("") if state == "caught" then icon:SetTexture(BenillaFishingJournal_Icon(item)) icon:SetVertexColor(1, 1, 1) icon:Show() elseif state == "silhouette" then icon:SetTexture(BENILLA_JOURNAL_ART .. "silhouette") icon:SetVertexColor(1, 1, 1) icon:Show() else icon:Hide() end if state ~= "caught" then BenillaFishingJournal_HidePips(slot) end slot:Show() end
function BenillaFishingJournal_PaintBait() local bait = GetFishingJournal() local slot = BenillaFishingJournalBait BenillaFishingJournal_Face(slot, bait and "caught" or "empty", bait) slot.kind = "bait" local held = BenillaFishingJournal_ItemCount(bait) BenillaJournal_Dim(slot, bait and held == 0) BenillaFishingJournalBaitCount:SetText(bait and held or "") BenillaFishingJournalBaitHint:SetText(bait and "" or "Drop bait here") BenillaFishingJournalBaitName:SetText(BenillaFishingJournal_GearName(bait)) end
-- The Pole and Lure slots. The Lure shows its durability as "14/20". -- Dim a slot's icon: the chosen bait none is held of, the lure the empty slot waits for. function BenillaJournal_Dim(slot, dim) local v = dim and 0.4 or 1 getglobal(slot:GetName() .. "Icon"):SetVertexColor(v, v, v) end
BENILLA_JOURNAL_SATCHEL_SLOTS = 25
-- The Satchel grid from the scroll offset: a count in the corner for a stack, "14/20" for -- a piece, and the chosen bait's slot lit. function BenillaFishingJournal_PaintSatchel() local frame = BenillaFishingJournal local rows = GetFishingSatchel() local most = math.max(0, math.ceil((rows - BENILLA_JOURNAL_SATCHEL_SLOTS) / 5) * 5) frame.satchelOffset = math.max(0, math.min(frame.satchelOffset or 0, most)) for k = 1, BENILLA_JOURNAL_SATCHEL_SLOTS do local slot = getglobal("BenillaFishingJournalSatchel" .. k) local name = slot:GetName() local item, count, durability, max, tackle, slotted = GetFishingSatchelItem(frame.satchelOffset + k) BenillaFishingJournal_Face(slot, item and "caught" or "empty", item) slot.kind = "satchel" slot.count = count slot.durability = durability slot.maxDurability = max slot.tackle = tackle local stack = "" if durability then stack = durability .. "/" .. max elseif count and count > 1 then stack = count end getglobal(name .. "Stack"):SetText(stack) if slotted then getglobal(name .. "Glow"):Show() else getglobal(name .. "Glow"):Hide() end end end
function BenillaFishingJournal_ScrollSatchel(delta) local frame = BenillaFishingJournal frame.satchelOffset = (frame.satchelOffset or 0) - delta * 5 BenillaFishingJournal_PaintSatchel() end
function BenillaFishingJournal_PaintGear() local pole, lure, durability, max, waiting = GetFishingGear() local slot = BenillaFishingJournalPole BenillaFishingJournal_Face(slot, pole and "caught" or "empty", pole) slot.kind = "pole" BenillaFishingJournalPoleHint:SetText(pole and "" or "Drop a pole here") BenillaFishingJournalPoleName:SetText(BenillaFishingJournal_GearName(pole)) slot = BenillaFishingJournalLure local shown = lure or waiting BenillaFishingJournal_Face(slot, shown and "caught" or "empty", shown) BenillaJournal_Dim(slot, not lure and waiting) slot.kind = "lure" slot.durability = lure and (durability .. " / " .. max) or nil BenillaFishingJournalLureCount:SetText(lure and (durability .. "/" .. max) or (waiting and "0" or "")) BenillaFishingJournalLureHint:SetText(shown and "" or "Drop a lure here") BenillaFishingJournalLureName:SetText(BenillaFishingJournal_GearName(lure)) end
-- The Legendary Fish of `zoneName`: a flat list of item, hintFound, caught triples. function BenillaFishingJournal_ZoneLegends(zoneName) local all = { GetFishingLegends() } local mine = {} for i = 1, table.getn(all), 4 do if all[i + 1] == zoneName then table.insert(mine, { all[i], all[i + 2], all[i + 3] }) end end return mine, all end
-- Paint the fish grid from `zone`, whose slot n reads zone[2n + 2] and zone[2n + 3] after -- the name, id and description. Returns how many fish are caught and how many there are. function BenillaFishingJournal_PaintFish(zone, legends) local caughtLegend = {} for i = 1, table.getn(legends), 4 do if legends[i + 3] then caughtLegend[legends[i]] = true end end local collected, total = 0, 0 for n = 1, BENILLA_JOURNAL_FISH_SLOTS do local slot = getglobal("BenillaFishingJournalFish" .. n) slot.kind = "fish" local item = zone[2 * n + 2] local best = zone[2 * n + 3] if not item then slot:Hide() else total = total + 1 local label = getglobal(slot:GetName() .. "Name") if best and best > 0 then collected = collected + 1 BenillaFishingJournal_Face(slot, "caught", item) BenillaFishingJournal_Pips(slot, true, best >= 2, caughtLegend[item]) label:SetText(BenillaFishingJournal_ItemName(item)) else BenillaFishingJournal_Face(slot, "silhouette", item) label:SetText("???") end end end return collected, total end
-- Paint the zone's four legend panels. Returns how many are caught. function BenillaFishingJournal_PaintLegends(zoneName) local mine = BenillaFishingJournal_ZoneLegends(zoneName) local collected = 0 for n = 1, BENILLA_JOURNAL_LEGEND_SLOTS do local slot = getglobal("BenillaFishingJournalLegend" .. n) slot.kind = "legend" local row = mine[n] local label = getglobal(slot:GetName() .. "Name") slot.hint = nil if row and row[3] then collected = collected + 1 BenillaFishingJournal_Face(slot, "caught", row[1]) label:SetText(BenillaFishingJournal_ItemName(row[1])) else BenillaFishingJournal_Face(slot, "silhouette", row and row[1]) label:SetText("???") if row and row[2] then slot.hint = BENILLA_JOURNAL_HINT end end end return collected end
-- "Water, Zone" for a named Fishing Water, else just the zone. function BenillaFishingJournal_Place(zone, water) if water and water ~= "" then return water .. ", " .. zone end return zone end
-- The page's text lines for `item`: its places, its own dish and cut bait, then one line -- per tier. function BenillaFishingJournal_PageLines(item) local caught, perfect, revealed, nextReveal, places, lives, kinds, peakFrom, peakTo, bait, dish, cutBait = GetFishPage(item) local lines = {} for i = 1, places do local zone, water, count = GetFishPagePlace(item, i) table.insert(lines, BenillaFishingJournal_Place(zone, water) .. ": " .. count) end if dish and dish > 0 then table.insert(lines, "Own dish: " .. BenillaFishingJournal_ItemName(dish)) else table.insert(lines, "Own dish: Learned on first catch") end if cutBait and cutBait > 0 then table.insert(lines, "Cuts into: " .. BenillaFishingJournal_ItemName(cutBait)) end local locked = 0 for tier = 1, 3 do if tier > revealed then local need = (locked == 0) and nextReveal or BENILLA_JOURNAL_REVEAL_AT[tier] locked = locked + 1 table.insert(lines, "??? (catch " .. need .. " to learn)") elseif tier == 1 then local homes = {} for i = 1, lives do local zone, water = GetFishPageHabitat(item, i) table.insert(homes, BenillaFishingJournal_Place(zone, water)) end table.insert(lines, "Lives in: " .. (lives > 0 and table.concat(homes, "; ") or "anywhere")) elseif tier == 2 then local water = (kinds == "") and "any" or string.gsub(kinds, ",", ", ") table.insert(lines, "Water: " .. water) if peakFrom then table.insert(lines, string.format("Bites most: %d:00 to %d:00", peakFrom, peakTo)) else table.insert(lines, "Bites at any hour") end else table.insert(lines, "Favourite bait: " .. (bait and BenillaFishingJournal_ItemName(bait) or "none")) end end return lines, caught, perfect end
-- Show or grey a texture; the grey is a 0.4 vertex colour where the API lacks the call. function BenillaJournal_Grey(texture, grey) if texture.SetDesaturated then texture:SetDesaturated(grey and 1 or nil) else local v = grey and 0.4 or 1 texture:SetVertexColor(v, v, v) end end
-- Whether the character has learned a profession; Fishing is open to everyone, Cooking once -- the Cooking Journal has a page. function BenillaJournal_Known(key) if key == "herbalism" then return (GetHerbalistInfo()) and true or false elseif key == "cooking" then return GetCookingJournal() > 0 end return true end
-- The bookmark column: the selected profession's tab is `side_tab_selected`, a profession -- that is not live or not learned is grey. function BenillaJournal_PaintProfessions() local chosen = BenillaFishingJournal.profession or "fishing" for i = 1, table.getn(BENILLA_JOURNAL_PROFESSIONS) do local row = BENILLA_JOURNAL_PROFESSIONS[i] local button = getglobal("BenillaFishingJournalProf" .. i) local bg = getglobal(button:GetName() .. "Bg") local icon = getglobal(button:GetName() .. "Icon") local live = row.live and BenillaJournal_Known(row.key) button.key = row.key button.live = live button.tip = (not live) and (row.tip or BENILLA_JOURNAL_LOCKED_TIP) or nil button.selected = (row.key == chosen) bg:SetTexture(BENILLA_JOURNAL_ART .. (button.selected and "side_tab_selected" or "side_tab")) icon:SetTexture(BENILLA_JOURNAL_ART .. row.icon) BenillaJournal_Grey(bg, not live) BenillaJournal_Grey(icon, not live) end end
function BenillaJournalProfession_OnClick() local button = this if not button.live then return end BenillaFishingJournal.profession = button.key BenillaFishingJournal_Paint() end
function BenillaJournalProfession_OnEnter() local button = this if button.live or not button.tip or not GameTooltip then return end GameTooltip:SetOwner(button, "ANCHOR_LEFT") GameTooltip:SetText(button.tip) GameTooltip:Show() end
-- Show the child frame of one bottom tab and hide the others. The chosen profession's -- frame shows; the other profession's frame of the same tab hides. The Cooking bookmark -- has no tabs: it hides them and every tab's frames and shows its Dish Pages. function BenillaJournal_ShowPage(name) local herbs = (BenillaFishingJournal.profession == "herbalism") local cooking = (BenillaFishingJournal.profession == "cooking") BenillaFishingJournal.pageName = name BenillaFishingJournalHerbPerkList:Hide() if cooking then BenillaFishingJournalCookPages:Show() else BenillaFishingJournalCookPages:Hide() end for i = 1, table.getn(BENILLA_JOURNAL_PAGES) do local page = BENILLA_JOURNAL_PAGES[i] local fishing = getglobal("BenillaFishingJournal" .. page) local herbalism = getglobal("BenillaFishingJournalHerb" .. page) local tab = getglobal("BenillaFishingJournalTab" .. i) local bg = getglobal("BenillaFishingJournalTab" .. i .. "Bg") if cooking then tab:Hide() else tab:Show() end if cooking then fishing:Hide() herbalism:Hide() elseif page == name then if herbs then fishing:Hide() herbalism:Show() else herbalism:Hide() fishing:Show() end bg:SetTexture(BENILLA_JOURNAL_ART .. "bottom_tab_selected") else fishing:Hide() herbalism:Hide() bg:SetTexture(BENILLA_JOURNAL_ART .. "bottom_tab") end end end
-- 1234567 as "1,234,567". function BenillaJournal_Commas(n) local s = string.format("%d", n or 0) local k repeat s, k = string.gsub(s, "^(-?%d+)(%d%d%d)", "%1,%2") until k == 0 return s end
-- Colour a list of font strings by name, without the drop shadow that muddies ink. function BenillaJournal_Ink(names, colour) for i = 1, table.getn(names) do local fs = getglobal(names[i]) if fs then fs:SetTextColor(colour[1], colour[2], colour[3]) if fs.SetShadowColor then fs:SetShadowColor(0, 0, 0, 0) end end end end
-- One-time styling at load: ink on the parchment and the large gear slots. function BenillaJournal_Style() local j = "BenillaFishingJournal" local p = j .. "Progression" -- The section bands are dark enough for their gold titles and white counts. local ink = { j .. "PoleTitle", j .. "LureTitle", j .. "BaitTitle", j .. "PoleName", j .. "LureName", j .. "BaitName", p .. "Title", p .. "XpText", } for n = 1, BENILLA_JOURNAL_FISH_SLOTS do table.insert(ink, j .. "Fish" .. n .. "Name") end for i = 1, 5 do table.insert(ink, p .. "StatLabel" .. i) table.insert(ink, p .. "StatValue" .. i) end BenillaJournal_Ink(ink, BENILLA_JOURNAL_INK) BenillaJournal_Ink({ j .. "PoleHint", j .. "LureHint", j .. "BaitHint", p .. "Caption" }, BENILLA_JOURNAL_FADED_INK) -- The Herbalism tab's gear and plant names, perk page and caption. local h = j .. "Herb" local herbInk = { h .. "ToolTitle", h .. "ConsumableTitle", h .. "ToolName", h .. "ConsumableName", h .. "ProgressionTitle", h .. "ProgressionXpText" } for n = 1, BENILLA_JOURNAL_HERB_SLOTS do table.insert(herbInk, h .. "Plant" .. n .. "Name") end BenillaJournal_Ink(herbInk, BENILLA_JOURNAL_INK) BenillaJournal_Ink({ h .. "ToolHint", h .. "ConsumableHint", h .. "Caption", h .. "PerkCaption" }, BENILLA_JOURNAL_FADED_INK) -- The Dish Page cards; the meal's name keeps its quality colour on its band. local dishInk, dishFaded = { j .. "CookCount" }, {} for n = 1, BENILLA_JOURNAL_DISH_SLOTS do local card = j .. "Dish" .. n table.insert(dishInk, card .. "Needs") table.insert(dishInk, card .. "Cooked") table.insert(dishFaded, card .. "Kind") table.insert(dishFaded, card .. "First") end BenillaJournal_Ink(dishInk, BENILLA_JOURNAL_INK) BenillaJournal_Ink(dishFaded, BENILLA_JOURNAL_FADED_INK) for _, key in ipairs({ "Pole", "Lure", "Bait", "HerbTool", "HerbConsumable" }) do local slot = j .. key getglobal(slot .. "Frame"):SetTexture(BENILLA_JOURNAL_ART .. "gear_slot") local icon = getglobal(slot .. "Icon") icon:SetWidth(48) icon:SetHeight(48) local name = getglobal(slot .. "Name") name:SetWidth(100) name:SetHeight(26) end BenillaCookJournal_Build() end
function BenillaJournalTalent_OnEnter() if not GameTooltip then return end GameTooltip:SetOwner(this, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:SetText("Fishing talents are coming later.") GameTooltip:Show() end
-- The Progression page: the level badge, title and XP bar, the locked tree and five stats. function BenillaJournal_PaintProgression() local p = "BenillaFishingJournalProgression" local level, xp, toNext, title = GetAnglerInfo() getglobal(p .. "Level"):SetText(level) getglobal(p .. "Title"):SetText(title or "") local fill = getglobal(p .. "XpFill") if level == 0 then getglobal(p .. "XpText"):SetText("0 / 0 XP") fill:Hide() else fill:Show() if toNext > 0 then fill:SetWidth(math.max(1, BENILLA_JOURNAL_XP_WIDTH * math.min(xp / toNext, 1))) getglobal(p .. "XpText"):SetText(BenillaJournal_Commas(xp) .. " / " .. BenillaJournal_Commas(toNext) .. " XP") else fill:SetWidth(BENILLA_JOURNAL_XP_WIDTH) getglobal(p .. "XpText"):SetText("Max level") end end local _, zoneCount, casts, caught = GetFishingJournal() local seen, known, counted, found, discovered = {}, 0, {}, 0, 0 for z = 1, zoneCount do local zone = { GetFishingJournalZone(z) } local hit = false for i = 4, table.getn(zone), 2 do local item, best = zone[i], zone[i + 1] if not seen[item] then seen[item] = true known = known + 1 end if best and best > 0 then hit = true if not counted[item] then counted[item] = true found = found + 1 end end end if hit then discovered = discovered + 1 end end local legends = { GetFishingLegends() } local legendCaught, legendTotal = 0, 0 for i = 1, table.getn(legends), 4 do legendTotal = legendTotal + 1 if legends[i + 3] then legendCaught = legendCaught + 1 end end local labels = { "Total Fish Caught", "Unique Fish", "Legendary Fish", "Zones Discovered", "Total Casts" } local values = { BenillaJournal_Commas(caught), found .. " / " .. known, legendCaught .. " / " .. legendTotal, discovered .. " / " .. zoneCount, BenillaJournal_Commas(casts), } for i = 1, 5 do getglobal(p .. "StatLabel" .. i):SetText(labels[i]) getglobal(p .. "StatValue" .. i):SetText(values[i]) local stripe = getglobal(p .. "Stripe" .. i) if math.mod(i, 2) == 1 then stripe:SetTexture(1, 1, 1, 0.08) else stripe:SetTexture(0, 0, 0, 0.25) end end end
function BenillaFishingJournal_Paint() local frame = BenillaFishingJournal frame.missing = nil if frame.profession and not BenillaJournal_Known(frame.profession) then frame.profession = "fishing" end BenillaCookJournal_Layout(frame.profession == "cooking") BenillaJournal_ShowPage(frame.pageName or BENILLA_JOURNAL_PAGES[1]) BenillaJournal_PaintProfessions() if frame.profession == "herbalism" then BenillaFishingJournalTitle:SetText("Herbalism Journal") BenillaHerbJournal_Paint() return elseif frame.profession == "cooking" then BenillaFishingJournalTitle:SetText("Cooking Journal") BenillaCookJournal_Paint() return end BenillaFishingJournalTitle:SetText("Fishing Journal") BenillaFishingJournal_PaintBait() BenillaFishingJournal_PaintGear() BenillaFishingJournal_PaintSatchel() BenillaJournal_PaintProgression() local _, count = GetFishingJournal() local page = frame.page or 1 page = math.max(1, math.min(page, math.max(count, 1))) frame.page = page local zone = { GetFishingJournalZone(page) } local zoneName = zone[1] or "" local art = BENILLA_JOURNAL_ZONE_ART[zone[2] or 0] if art then BenillaFishingJournalScene:SetTexture(BENILLA_JOURNAL_ART .. "zone_" .. art) BenillaFishingJournalScene:Show() else BenillaFishingJournalScene:Hide() end BenillaFishingJournalZoneName:SetText(zoneName) BenillaFishingJournalDescription:SetText(zone[3] or "") if (zone[3] or "") == "" then BenillaFishingJournalZonesBand:Hide() else BenillaFishingJournalZonesBand:Show() end BenillaFishingJournalPage:SetText(count > 0 and (page .. " / " .. count) or "") if count > 1 then BenillaFishingJournalPrev:Show() BenillaFishingJournalNext:Show() else BenillaFishingJournalPrev:Hide() BenillaFishingJournalNext:Hide() end local _, all = BenillaFishingJournal_ZoneLegends(zoneName) local collected, total = BenillaFishingJournal_PaintFish(zone, all) BenillaFishingJournalCommonCount:SetText(collected .. " / " .. total .. " Collected") local legends = BenillaFishingJournal_PaintLegends(zoneName) BenillaFishingJournalLegendCount:SetText(legends .. " / " .. BENILLA_JOURNAL_LEGEND_SLOTS .. " Collected") end
-- ── The Cooking bookmark ──
function BenillaCookJournal_Place(region, parent, x, y, w, h) region:ClearAllPoints() region:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", parent, "TOPLEFT", x, -y) region:SetWidth(w) region:SetHeight(h) end
-- Brown recipe pages inside the same painted nine-slice frame as the other professions. function BenillaCookJournal_Build() local root, pages = BenillaFishingJournal, BenillaFishingJournalCookPages local place = BenillaCookJournal_Place local bg = root:CreateTexture("BenillaCookJournalBackdrop", "BACKGROUND") bg:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", root, "TOPLEFT", 8, -8) bg:SetPoint("BOTTOMRIGHT", root, "BOTTOMRIGHT", -8, 8) bg:SetGradient("VERTICAL", 0.12, 0.08, 0.045, 0.22, 0.157, 0.094) bg:Hide() local font = getglobal("GameFontHighlightSmall") and "GameFontHighlightSmall" or nil local subtitle = pages:CreateFontString("BenillaCookJournalSubtitle", "ARTWORK", font) subtitle:SetJustifyH("LEFT") subtitle:SetTextColor(0.788, 0.690, 0.541) place(subtitle, pages, 52, 62, 720, 16) local caption = pages:CreateFontString(nil, "ARTWORK", font) caption:SetJustifyH("LEFT") caption:SetTextColor(0.788, 0.690, 0.541) caption:SetText("YOUR RECIPE COLLECTION") place(caption, pages, 52, 88, 600, 16) local hint = pages:CreateFontString(nil, "ARTWORK", font) hint:SetJustifyH("LEFT") hint:SetTextColor(0.788, 0.690, 0.541) hint:SetText("Hover a dish to inspect it. Learn new recipes at a kitchen.") place(hint, pages, 52, 726, 560, 16) place(BenillaFishingJournalCookCount, pages, 692, 86, 136, 18) BenillaFishingJournalCookCount:SetJustifyH("RIGHT") BenillaFishingJournalCookCount:SetTextColor(1, 0.82, 0) place(BenillaFishingJournalCookScreen, pages, 722, 720, 68, 20) BenillaFishingJournalCookScreen:SetTextColor(0.788, 0.690, 0.541) place(BenillaFishingJournalCookPrev, pages, 680, 716, 26, 26) place(BenillaFishingJournalCookNext, pages, 802, 716, 26, 26) for n = 1, BENILLA_JOURNAL_DISH_SLOTS do local card = getglobal("BenillaFishingJournalDish" .. n) local name = card:GetName() place(card, pages, 52 + math.mod(n - 1, 2) * 398, 112 + math.floor((n - 1) / 2) * 198, 378, 182) getglobal(name .. "Name"):SetWidth(302) for _, suffix in ipairs({ "Kind", "Needs", "Cooked", "First" }) do getglobal(name .. suffix):SetWidth(354) end for _, suffix in ipairs({ "Needs", "Cooked" }) do getglobal(name .. suffix):SetTextColor(0.92, 0.88, 0.78) end for _, suffix in ipairs({ "Kind", "First" }) do getglobal(name .. suffix):SetTextColor(0.788, 0.690, 0.541) end end end
-- Expand only the cooking collection; the other two professions keep their compact book. function BenillaCookJournal_Layout(cooking) local root = BenillaFishingJournal if root.cookLayout ~= cooking then root.cookLayout = cooking root:SetWidth(cooking and 880 or 420) root:SetHeight(cooking and 800 or 660) root:ClearAllPoints() root:SetPoint("CENTER", UIParent, "CENTER", cooking and -18 or 0, cooking and 0 or 16) for _, part in ipairs({ "Backing", "Middle" }) do local texture = getglobal("BenillaFishingJournal" .. part) if cooking then texture:Hide() else texture:Show() end end local title = BenillaFishingJournalTitle title:ClearAllPoints() if cooking then BenillaCookJournalBackdrop:Show() title:SetPoint("CENTER", BenillaFishingJournalPlaque, "CENTER", 0, 1) title:SetWidth(220) title:SetHeight(24) title:SetJustifyH("CENTER") else BenillaCookJournalBackdrop:Hide() title:SetWidth(0) title:SetHeight(0) title:SetPoint("CENTER", BenillaFishingJournalPlaque, "CENTER", 0, 1) title:SetJustifyH("CENTER") end end if cooking then root:SetScale(math.min(1, (GetScreenWidth() - 24) / 916, (GetScreenHeight() - 24) / 800)) else root:SetScale(1) end end
function BenillaCookJournal_OnEnter() if this.meal and GameTooltip then GameTooltip:SetOwner(this, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:SetHyperlink("item:" .. this.meal .. ":0:0:0") GameTooltip:Show() end end
function BenillaCookJournal_Turn(step) BenillaFishingJournal.cookPage = (BenillaFishingJournal.cookPage or 1) + step BenillaFishingJournal_Paint() end
-- "Combat Well Fed · Band 10"; a legend or plant meal has no band. function BenillaCookJournal_Kind(family, band) if band and band > 0 then return family .. " · Band " .. band end return family end
-- One Dish Page card from page `i` of the Cooking Journal. function BenillaCookJournal_PaintCard(card, i) local name = card:GetName() local _, meal, _, effect, family, band, numIngredients, cooked, first = GetDishPage(i) local needs = {} for j = 1, numIngredients do table.insert(needs, BenillaFishingJournal_ItemName(GetDishPageIngredient(i, j))) end local mealName, _, quality = GetItemInfo(meal) if not mealName then BenillaFishingJournal.missing = true end local r, g, b = 1, 1, 1 if GetItemQualityColor then r, g, b = GetItemQualityColor(quality or 1) end getglobal(name .. "Kind"):SetText(BenillaCookJournal_Kind(family, band)) getglobal(name .. "Icon"):SetTexture(BenillaFishingJournal_Icon(meal)) local label = getglobal(name .. "Name") label:SetText(mealName or "an unknown item") label:SetTextColor(r, g, b) getglobal(name .. "Needs"):SetText(effect .. " · needs " .. table.concat(needs, ", ")) getglobal(name .. "Cooked"):SetText("Times cooked " .. cooked) getglobal(name .. "First"):SetText((first ~= "") and ("First cook " .. first) or "Not cooked yet") card.meal = meal card:Show() end
-- The Dish Pages, six a screen, paged with the arrows. function BenillaCookJournal_Paint() local frame = BenillaFishingJournal local count = GetCookingJournal() local screens = math.max(1, math.ceil(count / BENILLA_JOURNAL_DISH_SLOTS)) local screen = math.max(1, math.min(frame.cookPage or 1, screens)) frame.cookPage = screen BenillaFishingJournalCookCount:SetText(count .. " known") local total, tried = 0, 0 for i = 1, count do local _, _, _, _, _, _, _, cooked = GetDishPage(i) total = total + (cooked or 0) if cooked and cooked > 0 then tried = tried + 1 end end BenillaCookJournalSubtitle:SetText(tried .. " recipes cooked · " .. total .. " meals prepared") BenillaFishingJournalCookScreen:SetText((screens > 1) and (screen .. " / " .. screens) or "") if screens > 1 then BenillaFishingJournalCookPrev:Show() BenillaFishingJournalCookNext:Show() if screen > 1 then BenillaFishingJournalCookPrev:Enable() else BenillaFishingJournalCookPrev:Disable() end if screen < screens then BenillaFishingJournalCookNext:Enable() else BenillaFishingJournalCookNext:Disable() end else BenillaFishingJournalCookPrev:Hide() BenillaFishingJournalCookNext:Hide() end for n = 1, BENILLA_JOURNAL_DISH_SLOTS do local card = getglobal("BenillaFishingJournalDish" .. n) local i = (screen - 1) * BENILLA_JOURNAL_DISH_SLOTS + n if i > count then card:Hide() else BenillaCookJournal_PaintCard(card, i) end end end
-- ── The Herbalism tab ──
-- The count of `item` the Herbalism Satchel holds. function BenillaHerbJournal_Held(item) local total = 0 for i = 1, GetHerbSatchel() do local held, count = GetHerbSatchelItem(i) if held == item then total = total + count end end return total end
-- "tool" or "consumable" for a Satchel item the slots take, nil for anything else. function BenillaHerbJournal_Use(item) local name = item and GetItemInfo(item) if not name then return nil end if BENILLA_JOURNAL_HERB_TOOLS[name] then return "tool" elseif BENILLA_JOURNAL_HERB_CONSUMABLES[name] then return "consumable" end return nil end
-- The Plant Page lines under the name: the picks, then the next unlock. function BenillaHerbJournal_PageLines(picks) local first, second, third = GetHerbRevealAt() local lines = {} table.insert(lines, "Picked " .. picks .. ((picks == 1) and " time" or " times")) if picks < first then table.insert(lines, "At " .. first .. " picks: a patch tells you it is there.") elseif picks < second then table.insert(lines, "At " .. second .. " picks: a patch names its rows.") elseif picks < third then table.insert(lines, "At " .. third .. " picks: its bush glows.") else table.insert(lines, "You know this plant by heart.") end return lines end
function BenillaHerbJournal_PaintZones() local frame = BenillaFishingJournal local count = GetHerbJournalZones() local page = math.max(1, math.min(frame.herbPage or 1, math.max(count, 1))) frame.herbPage = page local area, plants = GetHerbJournalZone(page) local art = BENILLA_JOURNAL_ZONE_ART[area or 0] if art then BenillaFishingJournalHerbScene:SetTexture(BENILLA_JOURNAL_ART .. "zone_" .. art) BenillaFishingJournalHerbScene:Show() else BenillaFishingJournalHerbScene:Hide() end BenillaFishingJournalHerbZoneName:SetText(area and (BENILLA_JOURNAL_HERB_ZONE_NAMES[area] or ("Zone " .. area)) or "") BenillaFishingJournalHerbPage:SetText(count > 0 and (page .. " / " .. count) or "") if count > 1 then BenillaFishingJournalHerbPrev:Show() BenillaFishingJournalHerbNext:Show() else BenillaFishingJournalHerbPrev:Hide() BenillaFishingJournalHerbNext:Hide() end local known, total = 0, 0 for n = 1, BENILLA_JOURNAL_HERB_SLOTS do local slot = getglobal("BenillaFishingJournalHerbPlant" .. n) local item, picks = GetHerbJournalPlant(page, n) slot.kind = "plant" if not item then slot.item = nil slot:Hide() else total = total + 1 slot.picks = picks local label = getglobal(slot:GetName() .. "Name") if picks > 0 then known = known + 1 BenillaFishingJournal_Face(slot, "caught", item) label:SetText(BenillaFishingJournal_ItemName(item)) else BenillaFishingJournal_Face(slot, "silhouette", item) label:SetText(BENILLA_JOURNAL_HERB_UNKNOWN) end BenillaFishingJournal_HidePips(slot) end end BenillaFishingJournalHerbPlantCount:SetText(known .. " / " .. total .. " Discovered") end
function BenillaHerbJournal_Turn(step) BenillaFishingJournal.herbPage = (BenillaFishingJournal.herbPage or 1) + step BenillaFishingJournal_Paint() end
function BenillaHerbJournal_PaintGear() local tool, consumable = GetHerbGear() local slot = BenillaFishingJournalHerbTool BenillaFishingJournal_Face(slot, tool and "caught" or "empty", tool) slot.kind = "herbtool" BenillaFishingJournalHerbToolHint:SetText(tool and "" or "Pick a tool below") BenillaFishingJournalHerbToolName:SetText(BenillaFishingJournal_GearName(tool)) slot = BenillaFishingJournalHerbConsumable BenillaFishingJournal_Face(slot, consumable and "caught" or "empty", consumable) slot.kind = "herbconsumable" local held = consumable and BenillaHerbJournal_Held(consumable) or 0 BenillaJournal_Dim(slot, consumable and held == 0) BenillaFishingJournalHerbConsumableCount:SetText(consumable and held or "") BenillaFishingJournalHerbConsumableHint:SetText(consumable and "" or "Pick a consumable below") BenillaFishingJournalHerbConsumableName:SetText(BenillaFishingJournal_GearName(consumable)) end
-- The Satchel grid from the scroll offset; the slotted tool and consumable are lit. function BenillaHerbJournal_PaintSatchel() local frame = BenillaFishingJournal local tool, consumable = GetHerbGear() local rows = GetHerbSatchel() local most = math.max(0, math.ceil((rows - BENILLA_JOURNAL_HERB_SATCHEL_SLOTS) / 5) * 5) frame.herbOffset = math.max(0, math.min(frame.herbOffset or 0, most)) for k = 1, BENILLA_JOURNAL_HERB_SATCHEL_SLOTS do local slot = getglobal("BenillaFishingJournalHerbSatchel" .. k) local name = slot:GetName() local item, count = GetHerbSatchelItem(frame.herbOffset + k) BenillaFishingJournal_Face(slot, item and "caught" or "empty", item) slot.kind = "herbsatchel" slot.row = item and (frame.herbOffset + k) or nil slot.count = count slot.use = BenillaHerbJournal_Use(item) getglobal(name .. "Stack"):SetText((count and count > 1) and count or "") if item and (item == tool or item == consumable) then getglobal(name .. "Glow"):Show() else getglobal(name .. "Glow"):Hide() end end end
function BenillaHerbJournal_ScrollSatchel(delta) BenillaFishingJournal.herbOffset = (BenillaFishingJournal.herbOffset or 0) - delta * 5 BenillaHerbJournal_PaintSatchel() end
-- A perk's colour: gold for a Boon, purple for a Pact, dimmed when `dim`. function BenillaHerbJournal_PerkColour(fontString, boon, dim) local c = boon and BENILLA_JOURNAL_HERB_BOON or BENILLA_JOURNAL_HERB_PACT local v = dim and 0.5 or 1 fontString:SetTextColor(c[1] * v, c[2] * v, c[3] * v) end
-- The perk `key` as `key, name, isBoon, text`, or nothing for a key the realm did not list. function BenillaHerbJournal_FindPerk(key) for n = 1, GetNumHerbPerks() do local k, name, boon, text = GetHerbPerk(n) if k == key then return k, name, boon, text end end end
-- The Progression page: the level badge, title and XP bar, then one row per perk slot. function BenillaHerbJournal_PaintProgression() local p = "BenillaFishingJournalHerbProgression" local _, level, xp, toNext, title = GetHerbalistInfo() getglobal(p .. "Level"):SetText(level) getglobal(p .. "Title"):SetText(title or "") local fill = getglobal(p .. "XpFill") if level == 0 then getglobal(p .. "XpText"):SetText("0 / 0 XP") fill:Hide() else fill:Show() if toNext > 0 then fill:SetWidth(math.max(1, BENILLA_JOURNAL_XP_WIDTH * math.min(xp / toNext, 1))) getglobal(p .. "XpText"):SetText(BenillaJournal_Commas(xp) .. " / " .. BenillaJournal_Commas(toNext) .. " XP") else fill:SetWidth(BENILLA_JOURNAL_XP_WIDTH) getglobal(p .. "XpText"):SetText("Max level") end end local slots = GetHerbPerkSlots() local taken = {} for i = 1, slots do local key = GetHerbPerkSlot(i) if key then taken[key] = true end end BenillaFishingJournal.herbTaken = taken for i = 1, BENILLA_JOURNAL_HERB_PERK_ROWS do local row = getglobal("BenillaFishingJournalHerbPerk" .. i) local name = getglobal(row:GetName() .. "Name") local text = getglobal(row:GetName() .. "Text") row.index = i if i > slots then row.state = "locked" name:SetText("Locked") name:SetTextColor(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) text:SetText("Unlocks at Herbalist Level " .. (i * BENILLA_JOURNAL_HERB_PERK_EVERY)) else local key = GetHerbPerkSlot(i) if key then local _, perkName, boon, perkText = BenillaHerbJournal_FindPerk(key) row.state = "filled" name:SetText(perkName or key) BenillaHerbJournal_PerkColour(name, boon, false) text:SetText(perkText or "") else row.state = "empty" name:SetText("Choose a perk") name:SetTextColor(1, 1, 1) text:SetText("Click to see the perks. A choice is permanent.") end end end end
function BenillaHerbJournal_Paint() BenillaHerbJournal_PaintZones() BenillaHerbJournal_PaintGear() BenillaHerbJournal_PaintSatchel() BenillaHerbJournal_PaintProgression() end
-- An empty, opened perk row lists every perk to choose from. function BenillaHerbJournal_PerkRow_OnClick() local row = this if row.state ~= "empty" then return end BenillaFishingJournal.perkSlot = row.index for n = 1, BENILLA_JOURNAL_HERB_PERKS do local choice = getglobal("BenillaFishingJournalHerbPerkChoice" .. n) local key, name, boon, text = GetHerbPerk(n) if not key then choice:Hide() else local taken = BenillaFishingJournal.herbTaken and BenillaFishingJournal.herbTaken[key] choice.key = key choice.perkName = name choice.taken = taken local label = getglobal(choice:GetName() .. "Name") label:SetText(name .. (taken and " (chosen)" or "")) BenillaHerbJournal_PerkColour(label, boon, taken) getglobal(choice:GetName() .. "Text"):SetText(text) choice:Show() end end BenillaFishingJournalHerbPerkList:Show() end
-- A perk in the list asks for confirmation; the stock static popup calls PickHerbPerk. function BenillaHerbJournal_Choice_OnClick() local choice = this local slot = BenillaFishingJournal.perkSlot if choice.taken or not choice.key or not slot then return end -- Registered on use, since the stock StaticPopup.lua may load after this file. StaticPopupDialogs = StaticPopupDialogs or {} StaticPopupDialogs["BENILLA_HERB_PICK_PERK"] = { text = "This choice is permanent. Choose %s?", button1 = "Choose", button2 = "Cancel", timeout = 0, whileDead = 1, hideOnEscape = 1, OnAccept = function(data) PickHerbPerk(data.slot, data.key) BenillaFishingJournalHerbPerkList:Hide() end, } StaticPopup_Show("BENILLA_HERB_PICK_PERK", choice.perkName, nil, { slot = slot, key = choice.key }) end
-- Left-click on a Satchel tool or consumable slots it; right-click on the Consumable slot -- empties it (the Tool slot cannot be emptied) and on a Satchel item withdraws the stack, -- or one with shift. Returns whether the slot was a Herbalism one. function BenillaHerbJournal_OnClick(slot, button) if slot.kind == "herbsatchel" then if BenillaFishingJournal_Deposit() or not slot.item then return true end if button == "RightButton" then local one = (IsShiftKeyDown and IsShiftKeyDown()) and true or false WithdrawHerbItem(slot.row, one) elseif slot.use == "tool" then SetHerbTool(slot.item) elseif slot.use == "consumable" then SetHerbConsumable(slot.item) end return true elseif slot.kind == "herbtool" or slot.kind == "herbconsumable" then if BenillaFishingJournal_Deposit() then return true end if button == "RightButton" and slot.kind == "herbconsumable" then SetHerbConsumable(nil) end return true end return false end
-- The tooltip of a Herbalism slot. Returns whether the slot was one. function BenillaHerbJournal_OnEnter(slot) local kind = slot.kind if kind == "plant" then if slot.picks and slot.picks > 0 then local name, _, quality = GetItemInfo(slot.item) local r, g, b = 1, 1, 1 if GetItemQualityColor then r, g, b = GetItemQualityColor(quality or 1) end GameTooltip:SetText(name or "an unknown item", r, g, b) local lines = BenillaHerbJournal_PageLines(slot.picks) for i = 1, table.getn(lines) do GameTooltip:AddLine(lines[i], 1, 1, 1, 1) end else GameTooltip:SetText(BENILLA_JOURNAL_HERB_UNKNOWN) GameTooltip:AddLine("Pick it to learn more.", 1, 1, 1, 1) end elseif kind == "herbsatchel" then if not slot.item then return true end GameTooltip:SetHyperlink("item:" .. slot.item .. ":0:0:0") if slot.use then GameTooltip:AddLine("Left-click to use it. Right-click to withdraw.", 1, 1, 1, 1) else GameTooltip:AddLine("Right-click to withdraw.", 1, 1, 1, 1) end elseif kind == "herbtool" or kind == "herbconsumable" then if slot.item then GameTooltip:SetHyperlink("item:" .. slot.item .. ":0:0:0") elseif kind == "herbtool" then GameTooltip:SetText("Tool") else GameTooltip:SetText("Consumable") end if kind == "herbconsumable" then GameTooltip:AddLine("Left-click one in the Satchel to slot it. Right-click to empty.", 1, 1, 1, 1) else GameTooltip:AddLine("Left-click one in the Satchel to swap it.", 1, 1, 1, 1) end else return false end GameTooltip:Show() return true end
function BenillaFishingJournal_Turn(step) local frame = BenillaFishingJournal frame.page = (frame.page or 1) + step BenillaFishingJournal_Paint() end
function BenillaFishingJournal_Toggle() if BenillaFishingJournal:IsShown() then BenillaFishingJournal:Hide() else BenillaFishingJournal:Show() end end
-- A bait item dropped from the bags goes into the Satchel and becomes the bait. function BenillaFishingJournalBait_Receive() local item = BenillaGetCursorItem() if item and BenillaFishingJournal_Deposit() then SetFishingBait(item) end end
-- A pole or lure dropped from the bags goes into the Satchel, then into its slot; the -- realm refuses any other item. function BenillaFishingJournalGear_Receive(which) local item = BenillaGetCursorItem() if item and BenillaFishingJournal_Deposit() then SetFishingGear(which, item, nil) end end
-- A bag item on the cursor goes into the Satchel. Returns whether one did. function BenillaFishingJournal_Deposit() local bag, slot = BenillaGetCursorItemPos() if not bag then return false end DepositFishingItem(bag, slot) ClearCursor() return true end
-- A Satchel slot: a bag item dropped on it deposits; left-click slots tackle (a counted -- row is bait, a piece the client knows to be equippable is a pole, any other piece a -- lure); right-click withdraws a stack, shift-right-click one. function BenillaFishingJournalSatchel_OnClick(slot, button) if BenillaFishingJournal_Deposit() or not slot.item then return end if button == "RightButton" then local count = slot.count or 1 if IsShiftKeyDown and IsShiftKeyDown() then count = 1 elseif not slot.durability then local _, _, _, _, _, _, stack = GetItemInfo(slot.item) if stack and stack > 0 then count = math.min(count, stack) end end WithdrawFishingItem(slot.item, slot.durability, count) elseif slot.tackle then if not slot.durability then SetFishingBait(slot.item) else local _, _, _, _, _, _, _, equipLoc = GetItemInfo(slot.item) local which = (equipLoc and equipLoc ~= "") and "POLE" or "LURE" SetFishingGear(which, slot.item, slot.durability) end end end
function BenillaFishingJournalSlot_OnClick(button) local slot = this if BenillaHerbJournal_OnClick(slot, button) then return end if slot.kind == "satchel" then BenillaFishingJournalSatchel_OnClick(slot, button) elseif slot == BenillaFishingJournalBait then if button == "RightButton" then SetFishingBait(nil) else BenillaFishingJournalBait_Receive() end elseif slot == BenillaFishingJournalPole or slot == BenillaFishingJournalLure then local which = (slot == BenillaFishingJournalPole) and "POLE" or "LURE" if button == "RightButton" then ClearFishingGear(which) else BenillaFishingJournalGear_Receive(which) end end end
function BenillaFishingJournalSlot_OnEnter() local slot = this if not GameTooltip then return end GameTooltip:SetOwner(slot, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") if BenillaHerbJournal_OnEnter(slot) then return end if slot.kind == "satchel" and not slot.item then return end if slot.caught and slot.item then GameTooltip:SetHyperlink("item:" .. slot.item .. ":0:0:0") if slot.durability and (slot.kind == "lure" or slot.kind == "satchel") then local max = slot.maxDurability and (" / " .. slot.maxDurability) or "" GameTooltip:AddLine("Durability " .. slot.durability .. max, 1, 1, 1) elseif (slot.kind == "fish" or slot.kind == "satchel") and GetFishPage(slot.item) then GameTooltip:AddLine(" ") local lines = BenillaFishingJournal_PageLines(slot.item) for i = 1, table.getn(lines) do GameTooltip:AddLine(lines[i], 1, 1, 1, 1) end end elseif slot.kind == "fish" then GameTooltip:SetText("???") GameTooltip:AddLine("Catch it to learn more.", 1, 1, 1, 1) elseif slot.kind == "pole" then GameTooltip:SetText("Fishing pole") GameTooltip:AddLine("Drop a pole from your bags here. Right-click to clear.", 1, 1, 1, 1) elseif slot.kind == "lure" then GameTooltip:SetText("Lure") GameTooltip:AddLine("Drop a lure from your bags here. Right-click to clear.", 1, 1, 1, 1) elseif slot.kind == "bait" then GameTooltip:SetText("Bait") GameTooltip:AddLine("Drop bait from your bags here. Right-click to clear.", 1, 1, 1, 1) elseif slot.hint then GameTooltip:SetText("Legendary fish") GameTooltip:AddLine(slot.hint, 1, 1, 1, 1) else GameTooltip:SetText("???") end GameTooltip:Show() end
function BenillaFishingJournalSlot_OnLeave() if GameTooltip then GameTooltip:Hide() end end
function BenillaFishingJournal_OnEvent() if BenillaFishingJournal:IsShown() then BenillaFishingJournal_Paint() end end
